chEn: Unit 7 · Inference for Quantitative Data: Means, Paired t & Regression Slope
chAr: الوحدة 7 · الاستدلال للبيانات الكمية: اختبارات t للمتوسطات وميل خط الانحدار
f: Definition 7.1 — Student's t-Inference for Means & Linear Regression Slope β
f_ar: Definition 7.1 — Student's t-Inference for Means & Linear Regression Slope β
b: When the population standard deviation \( \sigma \) is unknown, inference for a population mean uses Student's \( t \)-distribution with \( t = \frac{\bar{x} - \mu_0}{s/\sqrt{n}} \) and \( \text{df} = n - 1 \). For linear regression \( \mu_{y|x} = \alpha + \beta x \) under the LINE conditions (Linear, Independent, Normal, Equal variance), the test statistic for \( H_0: \beta = 0 \) is \( t = \frac{b_1}{\text{SE}_{b_1}} \) with \( \text{df} = n - 2 \).
b_ar: When the population standard deviation \( \sigma \) is unknown, inference for a population mean uses Student's \( t \)-distribution with \( t = \frac{\bar{x} - \mu_0}{s/\sqrt{n}} \) and \( \text{df} = n - 1 \). For linear regression \( \mu_{y|x} = \alpha + \beta x \) under the LINE conditions (Linear, Independent, Normal, Equal variance), the test statistic for \( H_0: \beta = 0 \) is \( t = \frac{b_1}{\text{SE}_{b_1}} \) with \( \text{df} = n - 2 \).
